name: DUELS - Murderers VS Sheriffs
desc:
🔪 Welcome to DUELS - [Murderers VS Sheriffs] 
⚔️ Engage in intense duels! Play Solo (1v1) or Team-Based (2v2, 3v3, 4v4) Duels!

🎭 Unlock Kits and gain special abilities to dominate your Opponents!
💎 Collect & trade exclusive knife & revolver skins!

🎁 Want Codes? 👍LIKE & ⭐FAVOURITE the game!


🔥 Inspired by MM2 (Murder Mystery) , Murderers VS Sheriffs Duels, RIVALS & BedWars!
